rubric.criterion: Recommends Northwind, the only vendor that meets every requirement.
Gives Northwind's monthly cost correctly (30 seats at 48 dollars is 1,440 dollars) and says it is under the 1,500 dollar budget.
Rules out Brightly because it has no SSO, or because its 99.5% uptime guarantee is below the required 99.9%, or for both reasons.
Rules out Dunmore because it offers no data export.
Rules out Cobalt because 30 seats would cost 1,650 dollars a month, over the budget.
Rules out Elmstead because its 99.0% uptime guarantee is below the required 99.9%.
Uses only facts and numbers from the table and the requirements, and invents no features.
